name: Mike Hagenow
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: Very close fit to physical human–AI collaboration: combines full-stack robot systems, demonstration interfaces, uncertainty-aware assistance and modern generative/vision-language-action policies. A bounded failure-monitoring or corrective-interface study could support this methods-focused research direction if hosting capacity exists.

physicalEvidence.summary: May 2026 Hide-and-Seek paper evaluates learned failure detection on real xArm 6 rollouts from a LoRA-fine-tuned pi0.5 policy, across eight cube/kitchen manipulation tasks with 25 demonstrations per task. The real-world policy is pi0.5; OpenVLA/pi0 are simulation evaluations. April 2026 RAPIDDS combines individual human-motion/timing models with diffusion-guided robot motions and a physical seven-DOF arm/user study. Current RT² people page separately lists four xArm 6 robots and a UR7e, establishing present lab hardware.

shortVisit.summary: Current join page expressly says the lab is not actively seeking postdocs or visiting scholars, while permitting strong-fit inquiries with CV, research history, visit goals and funding situation. Its 2026–2027 update limits PhD recruitment to at most one student; regular MS/PhD recruitment is not an external visit offer.
